title: Drum lessons with Mr. Catlett and Joe's objection
summary: He studied band drumming with Mr. Catlett (not related to Sid), but Joe said drums were too bulky to carry.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Then I took drum lessons for a while with Mr. Catlett. He was the best drummer around there as far as band drumming was concerned, you know.
Catlett. He wasn't related to Sid, was he?

No. I don't think so, no. So my brother knew I was getting stuck on the drums, and he didn't want me to go that route, because he said, 'One thing, you're not going to get too big' and... We were talking about this last night. The drums in those days were like 28 inches, you know. Sometimes bigger. And carrying all those drums, with the big tom-toms and the cymbals, it would be too much! And you didn't have no band-boys in those days, you know.
